notes:
New Features:

+ Adds an optional Skip channels after 3 failed checks setting and a Recheck Skipped Channels action that can restore recovered channels to the Adult TV Test playlist.

+ Converts the custom Settings window and controls to English to match Cumination and the Release Notes.

Bugfixes:

- Manual Site channel-status checks now update an existing Adult TV Test playlist using the completed check results.

- Keeps a safe second OXAX attempt when Auto Check is disabled while retaining faster single-attempt behavior for the other stable Site paths.

- Speeds up Site checks using the validated retry behavior from previous test runs without removing important failure fallbacks.
